description: A runtime description of data shape and rules that also yields a static TypeScript type via `z.infer`.
Validates without throwing and returns `{ success: true, data }` or `{ success: false, error }`.
One validation failure with a `code`, a `path` (such as `['email']`) and a `message`.
Converts input before validating, for example `z.coerce.number()` turns `'36'` into `36`.
Adds a custom rule. On objects, use `path` to attach the error to a specific field.
Adapter from `@hookform/resolvers/zod` that runs a Zod schema as React Hook Form's validator.
Shared interface implemented by Zod, Valibot and ArkType so tools can accept any of them.
